versions.changelog: Declare required credential in SKILL.md metadata (primaryEnv + requires.env). Fixes registry showing no required env vars.
Clarify hosted API (images uploaded to PDFAPIHub). Add privacy notice. Declare CLIENT-API-KEY credential in description.

OCR images using Tesseract with optional preprocessing (grayscale, sharpen, threshold, resize). Supports character whitelisting for digits-only extraction. Returns text with confidence scores and optional word-level bounding boxes.
